snapshotPurpose: Fuel V2 classified session-history format-5 contract with exact tire-service counter evidence and public iRacing ruleset identity.

fuelV2History.migrationRule: Format-5 sidecars add the public WeekendInfo.DCRuleSet identity to the classified session scope. Format 4 already adds entry/exit exact tire-counter snapshots and deltas to stationary-service observations while retaining pit-lane windows. Formats 2 through 4 remain readable: only format 4+ can prove exact executed tire shapes when iRacing exposes the corner counters, and only a recognized DCRuleSet may qualify later timing calibration. The v1.2.3 snapshot proves the separate format-1 reader: legacy summaries remain readable as legacy-unclassified diagnostics and never contribute to classified aggregates.
